responsibility: Implements the additional machine-description patterns for the second-generation iWMMXt/WMMX2 instruction set. It adds the extended vector arithmetic, absolute-difference, averaging, multiply-accumulate, merge, condition-test, and other WMMX2 operations that build on the base iWMMXt support in iwmmxt.md, providing the extra RTL patterns needed for -march=iwmmxt2 targets.
